cause.en: A prerequisite for the request is not met, for example billing is disabled for the project.
cause.id: Ada syarat yang belum terpenuhi, misalnya billing proyek belum aktif.

user_fix.en: Check the project's billing status and account prerequisites, then send again.
user_fix.id: Cek status billing proyek dan syarat akun, lalu kirim lagi.

operator_fix.en: Enable billing or complete the missing account step for the project behind the key.
operator_fix.id: Aktifkan billing atau selesaikan langkah akun yang kurang untuk proyek pemilik key.

cause.en: The API key is missing, invalid or expired.
cause.id: API key tidak dikirim, tidak valid, atau kedaluwarsa.

user_fix.en: Send a valid key and check its status in Google AI Studio.
user_fix.id: Kirim key yang valid dan cek statusnya di Google AI Studio.

operator_fix.en: Rotate the key and confirm the deployment reads the new value.
operator_fix.id: Ganti key dan pastikan deployment membaca nilai yang baru.

cause.en: The prepay credit balance is used up.

user_fix.en: Add credits to the billing account or turn on auto-reload. Do not retry until credits are added.
user_fix.id: Tambah kredit ke akun billing atau aktifkan isi ulang otomatis. Jangan retry sebelum kredit ditambah.

operator_fix.en: Alert on low prepay balance and keep auto-reload on for production projects.
operator_fix.id: Pasang peringatan saldo prabayar rendah dan aktifkan isi ulang otomatis untuk proyek produksi.

message: your project has been denied access

cause.en: The key lacks permission, or the project is restricted, needs verification, or has a billing problem. The AI Studio project status shows which one.
cause.id: Key tidak punya izin, atau proyek dibatasi, perlu verifikasi, atau ada masalah billing. Status proyek di AI Studio menunjukkan penyebabnya.

user_fix.en: Open the project in Google AI Studio and follow the status shown there (Verification needed, Restricted, Payment needed, Unavailable).
user_fix.id: Buka proyek di Google AI Studio dan ikuti status yang tampil (Verification needed, Restricted, Payment needed, Unavailable).

operator_fix.en: Fix verification or billing for the Google Cloud project. A new key in the same project does not help.
operator_fix.id: Perbaiki verifikasi atau billing proyek Google Cloud. Key baru di proyek yang sama tidak membantu.

message: your api key was reported as leaked

title.en: 403 Your API key was reported as leaked

cause.en: The key was found publicly exposed and is now blocked from the Gemini API.
cause.id: Key ditemukan terekspos publik dan sekarang diblokir dari Gemini API.

user_fix.en: Create a new key in Google AI Studio and replace the old one everywhere.
user_fix.id: Buat key baru di Google AI Studio dan ganti key lama di semua tempat.

operator_fix.en: Remove keys from client-side code and public repositories; keep them on the server only.
operator_fix.id: Hapus key dari kode sisi klien dan repositori publik; simpan hanya di server.

cause.en: The project or account must be verified before it can use the free tier.
cause.id: Proyek atau akun harus diverifikasi sebelum bisa memakai free tier.

user_fix.en: Verify with a mobile device in Google AI Studio, or set up billing to use the paid tier.
user_fix.id: Verifikasi dengan perangkat seluler di Google AI Studio, atau aktifkan billing untuk memakai tier berbayar.

operator_fix.en: Complete project verification or link a Cloud Billing account.
operator_fix.id: Selesaikan verifikasi proyek atau tautkan akun Cloud Billing.

cause.en: The model named in the request was not found.
cause.id: Model yang disebut di request tidak ditemukan.

user_fix.en: Check the model name against the models page, or fall back to another model.
user_fix.id: Cocokkan nama model dengan halaman daftar model, atau pakai model lain.

operator_fix.en: Keep model names in configuration and update them when models are retired.
operator_fix.id: Simpan nama model di konfigurasi dan perbarui saat model dipensiunkan.

cause.en: Too many requests or tokens per minute or per second for the project.
cause.id: Terlalu banyak request atau token per menit atau per detik untuk proyek ini.

user_fix.en: Retry with exponential backoff and jitter (for example 1s, 2s, 4s) and a retry cap.
user_fix.id: Ulangi dengan exponential backoff dan jitter (misalnya 1 dtk, 2 dtk, 4 dtk) dan batas jumlah retry.

operator_fix.en: Spread traffic, check the project's rate limits, and request a higher tier if needed.
operator_fix.id: Sebarkan trafik, cek batas rate proyek, dan ajukan tier lebih tinggi kalau perlu.

cause.en: The daily quota for the project is used up.

user_fix.en: Wait until the quota resets or request a quota increase. Short retries will not help.
user_fix.id: Tunggu sampai kuota reset atau ajukan kenaikan kuota. Retry dalam waktu dekat tidak membantu.

operator_fix.en: Move to a paid tier or request more quota; alert before the daily cap is reached.
operator_fix.id: Pindah ke tier berbayar atau ajukan kuota tambahan; pasang peringatan sebelum batas harian tercapai.

cause.en: The service is temporarily overloaded or down.
cause.id: Layanan sedang penuh atau sementara tidak tersedia.

user_fix.en: Wait and retry with exponential backoff. The SDKs retry 429 and 5xx automatically.
user_fix.id: Tunggu lalu ulangi dengan exponential backoff. SDK otomatis retry 429 dan 5xx.

operator_fix.en: Cap retries and consider a fallback model for user-facing paths.
operator_fix.id: Batasi retry dan pertimbangkan model cadangan untuk jalur yang langsung dipakai pengguna.
